facts.business: Alufluoride Limited manufactures and sells Aluminium Fluoride (AlF3) and operates a captive green solar energy plant.

capacity_or_capex.timeline: During FY 2025-26, added 1.1 MW to existing 3 MW

capacity_or_capex.item: Term loan for expansion of Aluminium Fluoride production facilities

guidance_or_targets.statement: Exploring a new project to manufacture Alumina Hydrate for raw material security and as a separate vertical
guidance_or_targets.value: Objects of the Company amended, shareholders consented via postal ballot

guidance_or_targets.statement: Exploring other overseas and domestic projects in Aluminium Fluoride, transport of raw materials through Electric Vehicles, fluorine derivatives and value-added products from Silica
